name: tower_cam
notes: Forward camera. Mount position from data/cad/sensor_mounts.json (kart frame: x forward from the rear axle, y left, z up from the ground). Resolution, aspect and pitch from real frames (AutonomousKart camera_data, 640x480, horizon near row 228 of 480, so 1.5 deg down, not the CAD's 14). The lens model is unrecorded: hfov 70 deg is an estimate
